title: Dalai Lama meets John Mack about aliens

tellings.quote: The Dalai Lama also met with Harvard psychiatrist John Mack about aliens and expressed a similar companionship of worldviews.

plain: The Dalai Lama, the Tibetan Buddhist leader, is said to have met the Harvard psychiatrist John Mack in the 1990s to talk about aliens, and the two found their worldviews in close kinship. Michels mentions it himself, without naming a source, in an episode about the idea that we live in a hologram. He brings it up to show a major spiritual figure taking the alien question seriously.
